description: Delta ledger tracking how dsh-completion-guard adapts codex-context-guard protocol capabilities. Each entry separates the source fact from plan status, implementation status, deterministic tests, native platform acceptance, and release readback. A disposition of adapted/adopted with implementationStatus not-implemented is a planned alignment, not a shipped one.

entries.sourceFact: Stop protocol 2.0.0 (published v0.9.4): only an authenticated, current-turn, full-coverage checkpoint can mark a task complete; assistant completion prose is diagnostic and never a control source.
entries.rationale: DSH keeps its native Goal Round Driver scheduling; the stop decision table is rebuilt so prose classification only produces diagnostics and uncontrolled turns safe-yield with pending items preserved.
entries.planStatus: planned in DSH v0.3.0 stop policy split (observeAssistantOutcome / decideTurnBoundary)

entries.sourceFact: Proof protocol 1.0.0 (published v0.9.4): deterministic proof contracts bind obligations to evidence with hash-bound manifests.
entries.targetRelease: dsh-completion-guard v0.3.0 (minimal state verification) and v0.4.0 (full proof manifest)
entries.rationale: v0.3 introduces effect plus independent state readback for the stateful action set with semantic action and target binding; the full versioned proof manifest (subject readback, scope coverage) follows in v0.4.
entries.planStatus: planned; minimal state_verification set is a v0.3.0 release gate

entries.sourceFact: Digest v3 canonical manifests (this repository, introduced with the semantic compatibility assets): session/host/evidence/binding/certification digests with golden vectors and a cross-language gate.
entries.rationale: DSH byte-mirrors tests/fixtures/conformance/digest_v3 and re-derives all 29 vectors with its own runner; digest identity inputs exclude telemetry refs by contract.
entries.planStatus: fixture gate frozen; DSH runner implemented against the byte mirror
entries.implementationStatus: codex-encoder-and-fixture-complete; dsh-runner-implemented (vitest re-derives all 29 vectors from the byte mirror)
tests: codex-context-guard tests/test_reference_digest_encoder.py (29/29 golden vectors, fail-closed negatives, --check gate)
dsh-completion-guard tests/domain/digest-v3.test.ts (byte-mirror pin and 29/29 cross-language vectors)

entries.sourceFact: Execution protocol 1.0.0 exists in Codex v0.9.4; not all surfaces are enabled through PreToolUse in Codex itself.
entries.rationale: DSH first needs a host coverage matrix (tools guard, permissions, sandbox, tool input digest, agent lineage, Goal CAS, high-risk write surfaces); an execution contract is only built against confirmed gaps.

entries.sourceFact: Classifier 2.3.2 (v0.8.12/0.9.4) keeps quoted completion phrases and meta-discussion diagnostic; direct completion assertions stay gated.
entries.rationale: The DSH stop policy rebuild keeps whole-completion and quote/assumption classification as diagnostic outcome codes only.

entries.sourceFact: v0.9.4 decodes Hook stdin as UTF-8 explicitly, independent of host locale, rejecting invalid bytes fail-closed.
entries.rationale: DSH has no Hook stdin surface; it reads persisted structured session logs, so non-ASCII prompt text is preserved natively.

entries.sourceFact: v0.8.11 Hooks fall back to the newest valid managed plugin cache when the original cache directory is removed, with strict version validation and a repair hint when nothing valid survives.
entries.rationale: DSH has no installed Hook cache lifecycle; plugin loading and lifecycle belong to the Cordis host.
entries.planStatus: not applicable to the DSH host model

entries.sourceFact: v0.8.11 installer explains missing historical caches and how to restore them instead of failing silently.
entries.planStatus: not applicable to the DSH host model

entries.sourceFact: v0.8.11 privacy classification inspects serialized token field values, allowing redaction placeholders and readable examples while blocking real-looking values.
entries.rationale: DSH sanitizes clause text by value patterns (bearer tokens, header values, quoted and bare secret assignments) before items are stored; value-based redaction is the existing behavior.

entries.sourceFact: v0.9.4 adds a standard-library incident corpus tool with reviewed, sanitized public fixtures used by CI.
entries.rationale: Cross-platform protocol regressions are expressed as portable conformance cases in the shared fixture; the corpus tooling itself stays Codex-only.
entries.planStatus: portable fixture layer established; case growth is continuous

entries.sourceFact: Codex persists a private schema-7 state ledger across the eight-Hook lifecycle.
entries.rationale: DSH persists in the native session log by design; the plan explicitly excludes porting the Codex private ledger.
entries.planStatus: not applicable; shared semantics carried by fixtures instead

entries.sourceFact: Codex v0.9.4 carries the deterministic proof contract surface classifier whose substring misclassification and capability adaptation gaps are scheduled for repair in v0.9.5/v0.10.0 (canonical locator, capability trust root, clause-level surface intent).
entries.rationale: DSH Layer B reuses the Codex canonical locator, capability priority, and clause-derived surface tuple semantics via portable fixtures after the Codex repair lands; DSH must not fork its own binding rules.
entries.planStatus: deferred until Codex v0.9.5/v0.10.0 semantics freeze
